scope.structuralContract: Every compiled public Graaly API type is exported to JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python; every generated member has Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python signatures.
scope.behavioralContract: Representative vertical plugins execute each runtime family and its failure boundaries. Context-bound operations are additionally exercised by live-server probes.
scope.honestyBoundary: Structural coverage is exhaustive. Behavioral coverage is family-based because blindly invoking every world, player, network, shutdown, and destructive overload would not be safe or meaningful without its required server state.
